current_activity: The 326th Volksgrenadier Division, in the West Wall facing Monschau, attacks with all three regiments
notes: Event date: CMH Ardennes ch. 5 p. 87: "In the two nights before the attack the 326th Volks Grenadier Division had moved into the West Wall fortifications facing Monschau and Höfen"; the division "had been ordered to put all three regiments in the initial attack". Event definition: the opening of the offensive on 16 December. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Monschau with a precision of 10 km, the town the division faced. Location approximate: a town point. Location support: CMH names Monschau and Höfen. Commander: Oberst Kaschner. Opponents: US V Corps (99th Infantry Division, 38th Cavalry).
